title: High-altitude nuclear tests burned holes in the Van Allen belt

tellings.quote: like the high altitude nuclear test they would just burn holes in the Van Allen belt

plain: Michels says that nuclear bombs tested high in the sky in the 1950s and 60s would "just burn holes in the Van Allen belt," the band of charged particles that Earth's magnetic field holds in place far above the atmosphere. He says this himself, in passing, without naming a source. If true, it would mean these weapons tests did damage reaching all the way into near space.
